verses.text: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

sections.title: The judgment that is given upon the coming of Christ the Redeemer.

verses.text: Brethren, I beseech you! Since your faith is exceedingly strong, and the love of each one of you toward one another is increasing, it is meet that we should always give thanks to God for you, as is fitting.
Therefore, in the midst of your afflictions and trials, we remember you in our prayers, for your steadfastness and faith in the Lord Jesus Christ.
For concerning Him, if you endure suffering for the sake of God’s kingdom, you shall be counted worthy, for this is a sign of the righteous judgment of God.
The Lord Jesus, with the mighty angels, shall be revealed from heaven in blazing fire, taking vengeance on those who do not know God and on those who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Those who do not know God, and those who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ, shall face judgment.

On that day, He shall honor our testimony among His saints, and all who believe shall be glorified, while those who do not believe shall be cast away from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of His might.

Therefore, as our God and our Lord Jesus Christ is gracious, may the name of our Lord Jesus Christ be honored among you, and may you honor Him; may our God grant you the strength to serve Him, and may all good works of faith be accomplished in power, for we always pray for you.

Nevertheless, brethren! Concerning our Lord, Jesus Christ, regarding our coming together unto Him, whether in spirit or in word, or as it is said among us in the message, "The day of the Lord is at hand," let not your minds soon be shaken, neither be troubled; we beseech you.
Let no man deceive you by any means; for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition.

"I am the Lord," thus saith He, until He takes His stand in the house of the Lord; above all that is called God, or that is worshipped, so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself as God.
While I am yet with you, do you not remember these things I say unto you?
In his own time, he shall be revealed; now you know what restrains him.
For the mystery of iniquity doth already work; only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus shall consume with the spirit of His mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of His coming.
For this cause, God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie; that they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
Therefore, for this reason, those who have not believed the truth, but have taken pleasure in unrighteousness, shall receive judgment, for God shall send them a strong delusion.

sections.title: The chosen ones for the poor.

verses.text: But we, beloved brothers in the Lord, ought always to give thanks to God for you; for God has chosen you for salvation through sanctification by the Spirit and belief in the truth, as a firstfruits unto life everlasting.
For this reason, you have been called to attain the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ through our gospel.
Therefore, brethren, stand firm; hold fast to the teachings we delivered to you, whether by word or by letter.
May our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace, comfort your hearts and establish them in every good work and word.

sections.title: Concerning the request that was presented regarding prayer.

verses.text: Brothers, I beseech you! Let the word of the Lord run swiftly and be glorified among you, and as it is fitting, let it also be honored. Pray for us, for faith is not for all, that we may be delivered from wicked and evil men.
But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.
And we have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command you.
And may the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God and into the patience of Christ.

sections.title: A warning concerning the work of diligence.

verses.text: Brethren! Let it not be as a tale received from us, but let every brother who walks without order be separated, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, we command you.
You know how you ought to be, for you are aware of yourselves; we do not walk disorderly among you.

Even if we should not be a burden to you in any way, we were working night and day in weariness and toil, that we might not be a burden to any of you, nor did we eat anyone's bread without paying for it.
This was to serve as an example to you, that we might present ourselves as a model, yet we are not without authority.
Furthermore, while we were with you, we commanded you, saying, "If anyone will not work, neither shall he eat."
For we hear that some among you walk in a disorderly manner, not working at all, but are busybodies.
Now such persons we command and exhort through our Lord Jesus Christ, that they work in quietness and eat their own bread.
But you, brethren, do not grow weary in doing good.
If anyone does not obey our word in this epistle, note that person and do not keep company with him, that he may be ashamed.
Yet do not count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
The Lord of peace Himself grant you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with you all.
This is the salutation of me, Paul, with my own hand; this is the token in every epistle: so I write.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
